description: ACCDB: (1) Field.Precision (direct + Properties('Precision')/Properties('Scale')) & Field.Properties inventory across TableDef and Table/Dynaset/Snapshot/ForwardOnly cursors on AllTypes; (2) Recordset.GetRows(3) across all 4 cursor types on AllTypes and on SELECT projection (all scalar/Binary/VarBinary/OLE/Decimal/GUID/Empty/Null cells); (3) Same-process multi-row UPDATE lock-wait timing on LockBig (60 rows across ~4 pages, ~17 rows/page) under SetOption(57,3)/SetOption(63,200) for plain UPDATE, dbFailOnError UPDATE, single-row UPDATE on locked page, and SetOption(57,1)/SetOption(63,100) plain UPDATE, bracketed by Signal AtUtc timestamps to measure per-page vs per-row wait time.
